user_query: I'm organizing a school event and I need a list of schools in Toronto. Can you fetch the key1 and key2 details of all the schools in Toronto using the TDot School Data tool? Additionally, I want to know the country where these schools are located. Please provide me with the country name from the SevenTraderAPI.
